chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan (may God be pleased with him) narrated that Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Humayri narrated that Harun ibn Muslim, from Mus'ada ibn Ziyad, who said: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:

Ten categories of female slaves are forbidden (for sexual relations): Do not combine between a mother and her daughter, nor between two sisters; nor your female slave who is pregnant by another man until she gives birth; nor your female slave who has a husband; nor your female slave who is your foster-sister, nor your female slave who is your foster-aunt; nor your female slave who is menstruating until she becomes clean; nor your female slave who is your foster-child; nor your female slave with whom you share ownership.
ai.seo_question: What are the ten categories of female slaves forbidden for sexual relations in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Khisal*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) delineates ten categories of female slaves (*Ummahat al-Awlad*) with whom sexual relations are prohibited, extending the principles of *Mahram* (consanguinity, affinity, and fosterage) to concubinage. Notably, the prohibition during menstruation and for those pregnant by another master highlights the juristic distinction between mere possession and consummation rights in Shia fiqh. This enumeration underscores the structured legal framework governing domestic slavery, ensuring that the status of the slave woman does not negate established familial and physical purity laws.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 10-27 Muhammad ibn al-Hassan - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Abdullah ibn Ja’far al-Homayry quoted Harun ibn Muslim on the authority of Mus’adat ibn Zyad that Abu Abdullah as-Sadiq (MGB) said,

“Ten categories of female slaves are unlawful for their masters. Do not have sex with both a mother and her daughter (who are both your slaves); do not have sex with both of two sisters (who are both your slaves). Do not have sex with your female slave who is impregnated by another man, until she gives birth to her baby. Do not have sex with your female slave if she is the wife of another man. Do not have sex with your female slave who is your foster sister. Do not have sex with your female slave who is your fosterpaternal aunt. Do not have sex with your female slave who is your foster maternal aunt. Do not have sex with your female slave who is menstruating, until she becomes clean. Do not have sex with your female slave who has breastfed you. Do not have sex with your female slave whom you possess in partnership with someone else.”
